decisions.reason: Measuring the 3.3V and 5V rails does not change the standalone LDO, source-selection, activation, or load requirements.
The added 5V monitoring channel does not change the switched rail's voltage, loads, converter, GPIO control, or shutdown behavior.
Rail current monitoring does not alter the sensor modules, their interfaces, or their 3.3V supply requirement.
The monitoring-channel allocation does not change the AXP2101 battery, USB, VMID/VSYS, or normal-operation power path.
Monitoring both rails does not necessarily change the interboard connector pinouts, board power topology, or power distribution.
The source decision does not change the LEDs' 5V supply or their level-shifter requirement.
The rail-monitoring channel allocation is unrelated to the battery connector's series, pitch, pinout, mounting type, or unresolved labeling.
Measuring the power rails does not change the separate LED board's role, LED count, or LED family.
The monitoring-channel decision does not affect BOOT/reset controls or their capacitance values.
Rail monitoring does not change the selected ESP32-S3 module or its breakout requirement.
The monitoring-channel allocation does not change USB enumeration or the USB-C programming interface.
Monitoring the 5V rail does not change the LED power-cutoff behavior, GPIO5 control, or zero-standby-current target.
